text:
validator-bot: ALERT: /invoke v2 schema rejections increased in eu-west1 — 92 rejects in 12m; auto-reroute triggered 31 fallbacks to degen-route. Full sample capture linked.
kevin: eyeballing samples now. Pattern: clients sending `tools` (array) but our contract expects `tool` (single object). Many are single-element arrays, looks like a client-side batching quirk.
maria: did we flip the fncall validator to strict in the router canary? I rolled soft->strict for 5% on staging yesterday.
jamie: yes, router canary 0.3 included the stricter shape validator. Thought we'd be safe because SDKs promised backward-compatible streaming. apparently not.
sasha: telemetry: 78% of rejects come from account acme-inc agent v1.2.0. They batch tool outputs and always wrap in arrays.
nana: (cc @ana) they also upgraded their infra last week, maybe changed serialize logic. reached out to their eng.
kevin: operational problem: our current policy treats ANY schema reject > threshold as immediate degen fallback. That causes route churn and double token attribution (orig route + degen). Billing flagged.
maria: we should not treat tiny shape differences as hard failures. Need a middle-ground for pluralization/array-wrapping issues.
jamie: short-term fix: add a lightweight heuristic in router that classifies rejects into categories: `pluralization_wrap`, `missing_required`, `type_mismatch`, etc. Only escalate to degen if category == `missing_required` or `semantic`.
kevin: also emit metric tag `schema_category=pluralization_wrap` so dashboards can filter.
sasha: bump sampling for full response capture from 1% -> 12% for 30m for affected tokens so we can collect varied samples.
validator-bot: Incident INC-20260323-11 created and assigned to @maria, @jamie.
maria: plan: jamie opens a small PR for the classifier + metric tagging, I will deploy to EU canary in ~25m, and bump sampling window. Monitor latency and reject-rate.
jeff: (ops) Heads-up: the fallback gate change must not accidentally suppress real missing-field rejections. Add a short whitelist of required-field errors to always trigger fallback.
jamie: PR #4332 opened: https://git/repo/pulls/4332 — implements `schema_category` classifier, label `pluralization_wrap` when only plural key or single-element array present, and changes fallback gating to require 3 independent `pluralization_wrap` events in rolling 5m before auto-reroute. Also includes unit tests.
sasha: console ask: create `reject_reason_breakdown` metric (percent) in routing dashboard + top-5 patterns widget. We need context, not just counts. Ops will use it during oncall.
kevin: billing: current behavior charges original route + degen route. Filing BILL-20260323-9 to dedupe fallback billing and add `fallback_tag` so downstream billing can attribute tokens to original route only.
nana: SDK note: add compatibility notice in SDK changelog and provide opt-in lenient parser for agents <1.3. I'll coordinate a short migration doc for partners.
maria: sample log snippet: ```json
{
  "req_id":"req-xyz-999",
  "resp":{ "tools":[{"id":"gcal","ok":true}] },
  "validator":"expected object 'tool' but got array 'tools'"
}
```
kevin: also, add router heuristic that attempts a non-destructive normalize step before declaring a hard reject: if `tools` is single-element array and spec allows `tool` object, attempt to coerce for validation only (no persisted mutation) and re-run validator. Only log as `soft_coerce_attempt` if it passes.
jamie: added `soft_coerce_attempt` flag in PR — only enabled for canary EU. We will NOT persist coerced shape; it's purely for validation route decision.
sasha: after canary, schedule 45m postmortem and a short decision doc for console UX. Propose a per-route toggle `lenient_shape` in Console so customers can opt-in to accept shape variants.
maria: action items: jamie -> PR and canary deploy; maria -> sampling bump + monitor; kevin -> billing ticket + coerce proposal; ana -> contact acme-inc and share migration notes; sasha -> dashboard widget spec. ETA: canary deploy in 25m, billing ticket tomorrow, migration doc EOD.
kevin: ack. :thumbsup:
